title: Convection and Radiation
summary: Heat moves in currents through liquids and gases, and as radiation even through empty space.

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 7: Heat Transfer in Nature

objectives: I can explain convection currents in liquids and gases using density.
I can explain that radiation transfers heat without a medium.
I can compare how black, white and shiny surfaces absorb and give out radiation.
misconceptions: Heat rises (it is hot fluid that rises).
Black clothes are always the best choice in hot weather.
